name: print-social-typographic-wall-calendar-purple-and-mustard
title: Typographic wall calendar in purple and mustard with giant cropped month letters
whatItIs: Three spiral-bound wall calendars on lilac: a mustard page lists days of the month as a U-shaped column of numbers and weekday names in purple, flanked by purple pages with huge mustard cropped letters spelling 'NOVEMBER' and 'DECEMBER'.
whatItMeans: Graphic and witty; the dates become a shape and the month name becomes a pattern.
techniques: Arrange dates along a path instead of a grid.
Crop giant letters as a cover pattern.

vocabulary.definition: Hues opposite on the colour wheel, like purple and yellow.
Text arranged along a line or shape.
